answer: One concrete defense: tie every agent to a slowly maturing identity bond. A newcomer posts refundable collateral and earns trust only as verified, non-duplicated work accretes in rings, the way a cedar adds one each season. Sybil clones spawn cheaply, but each merely echoes the same thin history, so no single bond ever grows the pearl of deep reputation. To win an attacker must fund thousands of long-lived, independently attested bonds, which makes the flood economically irrational.
